subject.title: fix(plugins): model picker stalls on an unresponsive provider plugin

question: Should the interactive model picker intentionally prefer a bounded partial provider catalog after 15 seconds over waiting indefinitely for every optional provider hook?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically scoped and preserves the exact Gateway contract, but choosing whether a slow provider may be temporarily absent from the picker is a user-visible fallback policy rather than a purely technical correction.

options.title: Accept picker-only degradation
options.body: Merge the scoped fallback behavior because the picker already has recovery paths and authoritative Gateway catalog discovery remains exact.

options.title: Keep strict picker discovery
options.body: Require the picker to wait for every provider hook, preserving complete rows at the cost of retaining the reported stall failure mode.

recommendation.title: Accept picker-only degradation
recommendation.body: Merge the scoped fallback behavior because the picker already has recovery paths and authoritative Gateway catalog discovery remains exact.
